slides.headline: things nobody told me before i became a manager
your silence is an answer
slides.sub: say nothing about the missed deadline and your team hears that it was fine

slides.headline: nice is not the same as kind
slides.sub: nice avoids the hard talk. kind has it early, while it’s still small

slides.headline: your old job is not your job anymore
slides.sub: the work that got you promoted is the work you now hand to someone else

slides.headline: you won’t feel ready
slides.sub: nobody does. you get ready by having the conversation, not by waiting for the feeling

caption:
nobody hands you a manual with the job title. these are the four i learned late.

which one took you the longest?
